issues.description: The template Main.java (commented example usage) calls farm.feed(), but the problem specification and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This name mismatch between template and specification/solution can confuse students about which method to implement and will cause a compile error if the example code is uncommented.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template example with the specification: change the call farm.feed() in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or update the problem statement and solution to use feed() consistently. Preferably update the template Main.java to call feedAllAnimals() to match the UML and solution.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals() to feed all animals in the Farm, but the template repository's Main.java contains a commented example that calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) can mislead students — they may search for or implement feed() instead of the required feedAllAnimals(), or be unable to run the provided example when uncommenting it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example use the same name as the specification and solution: replace farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals(), or add a small delegating method feed() in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals() (and document it) so the example and spec are aligned.
